programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and "accepted wisdom" to find the real story. You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world.

programme.desc: Sports Scene brings you closer to all the action from all corners of the world, with highlights from across Europe, North America and China's top sports leagues. programme.title: Building Off The Grid (S6) - Building Off The Grid Utah Desert Cabin

programme.desc: Cody battles the dangers of dehydration searching for water and fire-making tools, while Joe gears up for mortal combat with aggressive feral boars.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Cat's in the Cradle
programme.desc: When an unexpected kitten shows up on Boss Baby’s doorstep, they go head to head against the feline enemy

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - One More Cup
programme.desc: Julien finds a bag of coffee beans in the Cove of Wonders and gets the entire lemur community hooked on caffeine.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Gran Day Out
programme.desc: When Gran moves into the cave with The Croods, she drives Grug nuts and embarrasses Eep in front of the first-ever group of cool kids.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Enter the Dragon Master
programme.desc: After absorbing the mystical Hero Chi of the Four Constellations, four panda kids enlist the Dragon Master to teach them Kung Fu

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Hidden
programme.desc: Puss stumbles upon the legendary hidden city of San Lorenzo, and soon finds himself forced to protect it from thieves.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Heat is On
programme.desc: On the hottest week of the year and a miserable time for babies, Boss and Tim infiltrates a country club with a very cool splash pad in order to find some way around their strict "no-babies" policy. Meanwhile, Banker Baby Benny visits the startup company to check on his investment. Tina has to cover up how the heat has split her coworkers into lawless factions fighting over a fan and a mist cooler.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - One Tricked Pony
programme.desc: An overworked and under loved Precious has to choose between the Templeton Family startup business or Crispin Biscuits’ fun playtime. Meanwhile, the company makes its first purchase: upgraded communicators! R & D Baby Simmons is reluctant to fix the model they have, which picks up signals from her favorite lvorian soap opera, "Bridges Aflame." Over a live broadcast, Simmons must convince the cast to tie up every loose plot thread before she has to lose the signal forever.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - The Blade of Marmora
programme.desc: Two paladins are led to the headquarters of a secret society

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - The Belly of the Weblum
programme.desc: Keith and Hunk embark on a plan to travel inside a Weblum to harvest Scaultrite crystals

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Patchwork Plan
programme.desc: Lucky and her friends try to prevent Aunt Cora from leaving Miradero.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Porcupine Has Quills
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Porcupine didn't have quills, she had the softest coat in all of Tinga Tinga… and Jackal wanted it. Despite warnings from all the animals Porcupine allows Jackal to invite her to his cave to keep out of the rain. Porcupine takes off her coat to allow it to dry, but while she sleeps naughty Jackal runs off with it. When she awakes Porcupine is covered in lots of tiny ant bites and they itch and they itch and they itch.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Lizard Always Hides Under Rocks
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Lizard didn't hide under rocks. He would scamper around Tinga Tinga pinching other animals food and keeping it all for himself. Then one day the animals decide to give greedy Lizard a dose of his own medicine. When Lizard realizes the error of his ways he runs and hides under a rock too ashamed to show his face in Tinga Tinga. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Big Chris' Big Jump
programme.desc: Big Chris has agreed to do a parachute jump for charity but loses his nerve on the big day. Can Roary talk him through it, just like Big Chris did for him when he got scared?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Brassless Bandfinal
programme.desc: The brass band booked for the Silver Hatch parade have cancelled. Mr Carburettor will be furious if he doesn't have music at his parade. Roary and his friends think up an ingenious plan...

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Crash Landing
programme.desc: Hellie makes an emergency landing. Despite everyone's efforts, Hellie won't fly again… what could the problem be?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Plugger's New Job
programme.desc: James has broken down so Mama Mia comandeers Plugger to run her about. Mama Mia has a wonderful time with Plugger and James is jealous. He tries to remedy the situation with disastrous consequences.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Big Chris Gets Lucky
programme.desc: Big Chris realises that he only ever has good luck when he has his lucky mascot with him. But what happens when he loses it on race day?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Silver Hatch Fun Run
programme.desc: Roary and Plugger really want Big Chris to take part in the fun run but Big Chris isn't so sure. Can they make sure he trains for it without even realising?

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Message in a Bubble Glitteretti
programme.desc: Kelp has a new trick with his bubbles: he can have his friends put voice messages inside that you hear when you pop them. But when Pixie decides she doesn’t want the others to hear what’s in her bubble, the chase is on to rescue it! Juniper is devastated when the traditional ceremony to celebrate her next level of spark achievement can’t happen. Kelp helps introduce a new tradition.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Home Alone
programme.desc: Aggro, Burple and Cutter are left alone in the roost to care for some dragon eggs, but a trio of tricky Slinkwings want those eggs for themselves.

programme.title: Dinotrux S1 - Towaconstrictors
programme.desc: Revvit maps a path to a magical forest where the Dinotrux can explore and have fun, but once they arrive the crew is startled by Towaconstrictors

This week, The Big Interview sits down with the four-time Premier League champion to reflect on his playing career and the mentality it takes to be a goalkeeper at the very pinnacle of world football. Cech reflects on his journey from Plzen to becoming the only player record 200 clean sheets in the Premier League.

programme.title: THE ART OF... - EP2
programme.desc: Legendary goalkeeper, Petr Cech, sits down with Will Perry to discuss the role of the goalkeeper in the Premier League and how it has changed over the years. Cech gives his unique insight into the mentality of a goalkeeper and reflects on his career before breaking down and analysing some of the key attributes that make a great goalkeeper. He also selects five iconic Premier League goalkeepers to build his dream keeper for the modern game.

programme.title: PL REWIND - EP12
programme.desc: With his calm authority and impeccable technique in goal, David Seaman was known as "Safe Hands" for a reason. The legendary Arsenal number one recalls his two Premier League titles, his most memorable matches, and his favourite Gunners' team mates.

programme.title: REVIEW OF THE SEASON - 20162017 (CHE)
programme.desc: A review of all the best goals, action and drama from Premier League seasons past.

programme.title: PL REWIND - EP17
programme.desc: A tale of two seasons - Gary Cahill recalls the Chelsea championship campaigns of 201415 under Jose Mourinho, and 201617 with Antonio Conte at the helm.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP20
programme.desc: This week's Big Interview sees two of Chelsea's biggest stars from different generations come together for a football masterclass. Considered one of the most technically gifted players the Premier League has ever seen, Gianfranco Zola visits the Chelsea training ground to talk to the man currently lighting up the Premier League, Cole Palmer, about various aspects of his game.

programme.title: CLASSIC MATCH - CHE v MCI
programme.desc: We delve into the Premier League archive to bring you a Classic Match from the 20092010 season.

programme.title: PL RIVALRIES - EP3
programme.desc: Will Perry is joined by former Chelsea player Scott Minto and Manchester City icon Shaun Wright-Phillips as they delve into the memorable moments, and rivalries between the two giants of English football.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP6
programme.desc: We sit down with Claude Makelele to reflect on the career of a true midfield master. Celebrated for redefining the defensive midfield role, Makelele shares his memories of life in the Premier League, from joining Chelsea during a transformative era to becoming the heartbeat of a title-winning side. With insight from teammates, coaches, and opponents, we explore the intelligence, discipline, and influence that made his name synonymous with the position he perfected.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP25
programme.desc: In a career spanning 20 years, Petr Cech established himself as one of the greatest goalkeepers the game has ever seen. This week, The Big Interview sits down with the four-time Premier League champion to reflect on his playing career and the mentality it takes to be a goalkeeper at the very pinnacle of world football. Cech reflects on his journey from Plzen to becoming the only player record 200 clean sheets in the Premier League.

programme.title: THE ART OF... - EP2
programme.desc: Legendary goalkeeper, Petr Cech, sits down with Will Perry to discuss the role of the goalkeeper in the Premier League and how it has changed over the years. Cech gives his unique insight into the mentality of a goalkeeper and reflects on his career before breaking down and analysing some of the key attributes that make a great goalkeeper. He also selects five iconic Premier League goalkeepers to build his dream keeper for the modern game.

programme.title: REVIEW - SUN 01 MAR
programme.desc: Highlights from the latest Premier League Matchweek. Review incorporates all the key moments and manager reaction from every fixture, making it a must-see programme for all Premier League fans.

programme.title: PL RIVALRIES - EP3
programme.desc: Will Perry is joined by former Chelsea player Scott Minto and Manchester City icon Shaun Wright-Phillips as they delve into the memorable moments, and rivalries between the two giants of English football.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP26
programme.desc: We sit down for an exclusive interview with the first of two new Premier League Hall of fame inductees, Eden Hazard. A celebrated footballer who lit up the English top-flight during his illustrious career; a winner of multiple domestic and European honours, he became a true legend of the Premier League era. He reflects on his rise to the top, the moments that defined his career, and the immense pride he feels at joining the elite ranks of the Premier League's greatest ever players.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP34
programme.desc: Extended sit-downs and more informal 'out and about' interviews with the Premier League's biggest stars, providing players with a platform to tell their story in their own words.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP44
programme.desc: With exclusive behind-the-scenes access, PL Stories spends time with Yakubu Aiyegbeni at Finchley Boxing Club, where he is forging a new path in the next chapter of his sporting life. We explore his growing passion for boxing and the discipline it demands, offering a fresh perspective on life after football. Alongside this new pursuit, Yakubu reflects on his remarkable journey from his early years in Nigeria to becoming one of the Premier League's most prolific and respected strikers.

programme.title: PL REWIND - EP15
programme.desc: Gianfranco Zola signed for Chelsea in November 1996, aged 30. The Little Magician became a trailblazer as one of the Premier League's first genuine flair players, and by the time of his departure seven seasons later, he had established himself as an all-time great at Stamford Bridge.

programme.title: NETBUSTERS - EP31
programme.desc: Fast-paced with music, ISO angles, and commentary, Netbusters offers an alternative review of every goal and key moment from the latest round of Premier League fixtures.

programme.title: GOALS OF THE SEASON - 20132014 (GB: SUAREZ)
programme.desc: We take a look back at some of the most spectacular and important goals from previous Premier League seasons.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S5 - Playing With Fire

programme.title: Cobra Kai S5 - Downward Spiral
programme.desc: Johnny and Carmen's romance flies high while Daniel and Amanda are rattled by Terry's schemes. The teens' feuds spill over at the waterpark.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S5 - Extreme Measures
programme.desc: Daniel leans on a friend - and frenemy. Tensions come to a head for Miguel and Robby. A familiar face returns.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S5 - Ouroboros
programme.desc: Terry recruits an expert in the way of the fist. Daniel walks away from a fight, and Johnny and Chozen pick one. In prison, Kreese confronts old demons.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S5 - Bad Eggs
programme.desc: Terry and Kim issue a brutal challenge while Chozen teaches his students a different kind of lesson. Johnny and Daniel demand answers from Kreese.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S5 - Taikai
programme.desc: A coveted spot in an elite international tournament ignites a fight between dojos. Tory's loyalties are tested. Sam struggles to let Miguel go.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S5 - Survivors
programme.desc: Tory pays a price for defiance. Stingray does battle with his conscience. A celebratory night on the town takes a turn for Johnny, Daniel and Chozen.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S5 - Head Of The Snake
programme.desc: A fight night erupts in the Valley as Johnny, Daniel, Chozen and their students summon all their skills and strength to expose Terry and take him down.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Ace Degenerate
programme.desc: 34 years after losing the All Valley Karate Championship, Johnny Lawrence decides to reopen the Cobra Kai Dojo while his school adversary, Daniel LaRusso, runs a successful auto business.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Strike First
programme.desc: Daniel is dismayed to find a new Cobra Kai dojo has been opened up. Johnny learns his dojo has to pass several safety requirements before he can actually start teaching.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Esqueleto
programme.desc: Miguel helps Johnny advertise Cobra Kai on the web. Daniel agrees to chaperon at the Halloween dance so he can keep an eye on his daughter.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Cobra Kai Never Dies
programme.desc: Robbie is in hot water with his father. Johnny plans to shut down Cobra Kai after Miguel is injured. Samantha and Kyler's relationship hits rock bottom. A vandalized billboard creates tension for Daniel.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Counterbalance
programme.desc: Cobra Kai gains it's second student. Daniel has an intricate plan to get payback on Johnny. Miguel defends Samantha against Kyler during lunch break.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Quiver
programme.desc: Johnny's dojo class attracts a group of misfits while his son Robby, who harbors ulterior motives, lands a new job. Samantha makes a new friend in science class. Daniel inspires interest in karate from an unlikely person.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - All Valley
programme.desc: When Johnny learns Cobra Kai is banned from the All Valley Tournament, he faces the City Council. Miguel asks Samantha out. Robbie takes lessons from Daniel, just as his buddies plot a heist from LaRusso Auto.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Molting
programme.desc: Johnny prepares his Cobra Kai students for the next All Valley Karate Tournament and in turn, he is inspired to clean up his life. Daniel is still unaware of his new pupil's background.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Different But Same
programme.desc: Louie's reckless actions forces Johnny and Daniel to go down memory lane. The Cobra Kai students plot revenge against the popular kids. Miguel grows impatient with Samantha.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Mercy
programme.desc: It is the day of the 2018 All Valley Karate Tournament and Cobra Kai is determined to win. Robbie signs up unaffiliated. A familiar face from the past returns.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S2 - Mercy, Part II
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Cobra Kai’s win at the Under 18 All Valley Karate Championships, Johnny questions his dojo’s philosophy and deals with a figure from his past. Daniel searches for the right way to respond to Cobra Kai’s dominance.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S2 - Back In Black
programme.desc: When Daniel starts teaching his first karate students, he questions whether he can fill Mr. Miyagi’s shoes. Johnny invents some unorthodox training methods with help from an unlikely source.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S2 - Fire And Ice
programme.desc: Daniel pulls out all the stops in an effort to recruit new students to Miyagi Do. Johnny reflects on some of the major relationships in his life - and responds to Daniel’s promotional efforts with his own.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S2 - The Moment Of Truth
programme.desc: Daniel makes another attempt to promote Miyagi Do, and receives guidance in a familiar form. Johnny grows suspicious about Kreese’s backstory. A new Cobra Kai student challenges Miguel and befriends Aisha, while Robby revisits a past he’d rather forget.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S2 - All In
programme.desc: Daniel struggles to help a new student learn. Miguel makes a new connection, while Johnny tries to repair a relationship. Tensions between the two dojos build to a breaking point.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S2 - Take A Right
programme.desc: Daniel’s students are given a lesson in overcoming their grudges. Johnny spends some time away from the dojo, while Kreese exerts his influence.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S2 - Lull
programme.desc: To prepare his students, Daniel gives some new training methods a shot. Miguel puts a new lesson into practice. Johnny makes a tough but pivotal decision that affects Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S2 - Glory Of Love
programme.desc: Daniel works to make amends with Amanda, while Johnny is introduced to the world of dating apps. Complications arise when Miguel, Samantha, Robby and Tory cross paths.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S2 - Pulpo
programme.desc: Johnny cautiously takes a stab at love, while Daniel and Amanda enjoy a romantic date night. An attempt to bring the students of the two dojos together backfires as hostilities between the teens escalate.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S2 - No Mercy
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school at West Valley High but tensions between the two dojos have not cooled with the end of summer. And the rivalry between Daniel and Johnny comes to a head.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - Aftermath
programme.desc: Miguel's fighting for his life, Robby's missing, and Daniel and Johnny's reputations are in tatters as the community reacts to the West Valley brawl.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - Nature Vs Nurture
programme.desc: Daniel and Johnny team up to find Robby. Miguel faces an uncertain future. Kreese tries to bring Tory back to Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - Now You're Gonna Pay
programme.desc: Daniel's tarnished public image takes a toll on his sales, leading to a takeover offer. Johnny tries to raise money for Miguel's surgery.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - The Right Path
programme.desc: Following an important meeting in Japan, Daniel revisits Mr. Miyagi's hometown in Okinawa. Johnny attempts to reconnect with Robby.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - Miyagi-Do
programme.desc: In Okinawa, Daniel spends time with an old friend - and an old enemy, who has much to teach him. The dueling dojos' rivalry comes to a nasty head.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - King Cobra
programme.desc: Miguel helps Johnny craft the perfect social media message. Kreese scouts new recruits while Daniel and Amanda try to shut down Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - Obstculos
programme.desc: Daniel spends some father-daughter time with a traumatized Sam. Johnny plans to form a new karate dojo but struggles to come up with a cool name.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - The Good, The Bad And The Badass
programme.desc: Informed that this year's All Valley Karate Tournament is being canceled, the three competing sensei attend a city council meeting to save it.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - Feel The Night
programme.desc: It's Christmastime in the Valley, and romance is in the air. Daniel and Miguel find unexpected common ground, and the Cobra Kai recruits go on a mission.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - 43800
programme.desc: Old wounds begin to heal at a country club Christmas party, but a brutal assault by Kreese's students leads to new betrayals and alliances.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - Let's Begin
programme.desc: Johnny and Daniel combine dojos but their opposing styles immediately clash. Kreese tries to persuade a former partner to rejoin him at Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - First Learn Stand
programme.desc: Johnny picks up defensive strategies while Daniels learns how to go on the offensive. Amanda confronts Tory. New kid Kenny is bullied at school.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - Then Learn Fly
programme.desc: Kenny tries to become a student of Cobra Kai with some encouragement from Robby, while Johnny urges Sam to take a leap of faith - in herself.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - Bicephaly

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - Match Point

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows - EP14
programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories - EP9
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long’s two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei’s (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP14
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP15

programme.title: The Conquest - EP7
programme.desc: During the Spring and Autumn Period, ancient China was divided into small kingdoms ruled by various powerful regional warlords. This was a time of massive upheaval when a myriad of dramatic stories took place. The more than 20-year-long fight among the man of virtue FAN LAI (CHEN KUN), the persistent and dauntless AU TSIN (LAU CHUNG YAN, DAMIAN), the legendary hero FU CHAI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and the mesmerizing beauty SAI SZE (KWOK, SONIJA) is a true classic that will long be remembered.

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories - EP10
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long’s two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei’s (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP16
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP17
programme.desc: Bookshop staff FONG HOK MAN (Chun Pui) always believes that "knowledge is power". He tries hard to encourage his older son FONG SUM MING (Lai Yiu Cheung) and his younger son FONG SUM CHING (Suen Eric) to study more. Unfortunately, MING is not good at studying at all and he quits after secondary school. On the other hand, CHING is a very smart boy and MING works hard overseas to support CHING’s further studies on computer sciences in America.

programme.title: The Conquest - EP9
programme.desc: During the Spring and Autumn Period, ancient China was divided into small kingdoms ruled by various powerful regional warlords. This was a time of massive upheaval when a myriad of dramatic stories took place. The more than 20-year-long fight among the man of virtue FAN LAI (CHEN KUN), the persistent and dauntless AU TSIN (LAU CHUNG YAN, DAMIAN), the legendary hero FU CHAI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and the mesmerizing beauty SAI SZE (KWOK, SONIJA) is a true classic that will long be remembered.

programme.title: When a Man Loves a Woman - EP1
programme.desc: Man (Kwok Tsun On), Fai (Ng Chun Yu), Wah (Esther Kwan) and Shan (Fennie Yuen) grew up together and were very good friends. Man, Fai and Shan even shared an apartment. Fai was a playboy. He liked fooling around without any commitment. Man, on the other hand, was very loyal to his girlfriend - Wah._x000D__x000D_Man and Fai treated Shan as their brothers since she acted like a tom-boy. However, Shan was in love with Fai.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP11
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Unchained Medleyr - EP16
programme.desc: Pop musician Ding Yat-chun (Owen Cheung) is often troubled by nightmares. He then gets embroiled in a plagiarism scandal, so he moves to a small village for the time being as he also wants to relax. Yat-chun unwittingly opens an old Cantonese opera costume trunk in the village house, releasing the ghost of opera diva Wan Lau-fong (Katy Kung). In the 1990s, Lau-fong was a Cantonese opera diva, but she passed away due to some accident. Lau-fong has forgotten almost everything about her human life.

programme.title: Succession War - EP2
programme.desc: HESHEN (Ruco Chan) supports PRINCE YONGYAN (Shaun Tam) to accede to the throne. Following QIANLONG’s death, EMPEROR JIAQING manages to convince HESHEN’s son FENGSHEN-YINDE (Matthew Ho) and confidant FUCHANG’AN (Joel Chan) to turn their coat, seeking to sweepingly eliminate HESHEN and his cronies. But, HESHEN comes prepared.

programme.title: Food Of Love - EP12
programme.desc: Gifted cooking talent Tak (Wong Hei) wants to be a successful chef. He does not give up even when his father Kin (Leung Ka Yan) is against the idea. His uncle Kwai (Lau Kar Fai) is on his side and finally Tak is given a chance to learn in a Chinese restaurant in a hotel. There he meets his dream girl Wing (Kennix Kwok) and wins her heart. Tak’s best friend Lam (Fennie Yuen) is upset when she learns about this.

programme.title: 名人书房第73集
programme.desc: 阅读引导我们漫步在别人的思想与灵魂当中13位名人的读书故事，13段动人的奇幻旅程~继2015年与中天电视合作制播《名人床头书》节目，邀请39位名人深度分享阅读带来的影响及美好，冠德玉山教育基金会于2018年起独立制作《名人书房》影片，以阅读为主题的实景记录，期待能呈现文学、艺术、设计、空间等风格意义，邀请王伟忠、五月天/石头、江坤俊、姚谦、郎祖筠、许芳宜、郭重兴、曾文诚、曾宝仪、郑丰、徐薇X大成、刘安婷X吕冠纬等跨界名人，由资深主播詹庆龄担任主持人，在漫漫的引言互动中，侃侃而谈对生命的感知、阅读经验的分享与追梦的过程。影片片头「名人书房」由《每日一字》书法家张炳煌挥毫，配乐为大提琴家吕超伦演奏

programme.title: 伴你同行第1集
programme.desc: 倪国俊在很年轻时凭著自己努力，拥有三家咖啡连锁店及设计公司，新婚后不久发现罹患僵直性脊椎炎，四处胡乱求诊延误治疗，妻子因此离开他，他人生陷入低潮，并自我封闭，生活陷入绝境。在最痛苦时，慈济人伸出援手，有如母亲的喜久师姊一路陪伴，两人从陌生人成为亦友亦母子的情谊，喜九丧子的苦痛经历也因此揭开而来，两人相知相惜，也丰富了彼此的心灵。

programme.title: 大爱全纪实第39集
programme.desc: 慈济四大八法推广与传播,关注地球与人类永续发展议题。 解读近代事件中，慈济「曾经」参与的足迹，至今「正在」持续的行动，以及留给「未来」的影响力。 为观众传播慈济四大八法，剖析探讨慈济人如何关注地球永续发展、推动拔苦予乐的希望工程。

programme.title: 名人书房第11集
programme.desc: 阅读就像是漫步在别人的思想与灵魂当中！每位名人的读书故事，皆是一段动人的奇幻旅程，透过《名人书房》纪录影片带领大众看见阅读改变生命的力量。

programme.title: 证严上人说故事第253集
programme.desc: 听故事，曾经是儿时最大的期待。好听的故事，更是百听不厌、刻骨铭心。 《证严上人说故事》是证严上人从多年生活历练中摘取得来的智慧结晶。在一则则风趣浅白故事中，她告诉我们，在生命的经营里，如果被『名』枷『利』锁绑住，而失去心灵空间，那将是一种无法弥补的损失。

programme.title: 风月同天第49集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法华经序系花莲静思精舍，于每日拂晓时分，僧俗二众的早课实录，意在启发自性本具的大乘精神；旨于引导大众常行菩萨道。除心无旁骛专注于当下课诵的经文外，同时扩及日常生活每一刻的专注、培养慈悲佛心，学习缩小自我，破我执，达到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 映照人生第497集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 风月同天第7集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 以身相许幕后制作第1集
programme.desc: 本片拍摄大爱剧以身相许的幕后制作,包括制作缘起,导演选角,演员与本尊互动,以及处理大体老师的相关职人,慈济大学临时演员等等,带领观众了解一出戏剧的形成过程,从中看见慈济推动大体老师捐赠的理念

programme.title: 大爱真健康第953集

programme.title: 行动现场第468集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: 无量义经偈颂第61集
programme.desc:
《无量义经》被誉为《法华经》的前导，也是大乘佛法中最能启发慈悲行的经典。对证严上人而言，这部经是毕生体悟最深的法门，更成为慈济法脉的根本依据。在 上人的带领下，《无量义经》成为慈济人行入人群的实践指南。
本节目以 上人讲解的《无量义经》偈颂为主轴，带领观众把经中智慧用在生活的每个当下，愿人人能从这部经中启发无量善念，为自己与社会带来更多和谐与光亮。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第657集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.desc: 包拯为北宋仁宗天圣五年（1027年）申科进士甲科，初任建昌知县，官至开封府尹及龙图阁大学士，这跟电视上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中国清官的典型代表，后世包括朱熹、欧阳修、司马光对他都有正面评价。宋仁宗年间，开封府尹包拯，通称「包青天」。为官清廉，为民伸冤，强调「人在做天在看」、「举头三尺有神明」不畏强权，除恶务尽。较脍炙人口的单元有「秦香莲」、「真假状元」、「貍猫换太子」等。

programme.title: 美味纵贯现第11集
programme.desc: 不但纵横古今带您穿透美味里的历史传承，也透过细腻的镜头重现精彩厨艺的繁复作工，更深入台湾大城小镇为观众找出健康美味的食材！

programme.title: 我们的岛第1351集
programme.desc: 一个一小时的节目，能带给观众什么，能影响什么？如果把它只当成一个节目，会感觉短短一小时很短暂，如果把它当成一条出路，会发现力量也可以很强大，一直以来，我们节目的理念就是寻求一种改变的可能性，只要有一个人因为看过报导而改变了，反省也好，感动也好，警惕也好，行动也好，就有可能形塑一种新的环境公民力量，也有可能让错误的政策不再继续。1998年11月1日「我们的岛」节目正式播出，当年台湾的环境还处于大肆开发的年代，在经济挂帅的氛围中，「我们的岛」为环境发出另一种声音，至今「我们的岛」仍是台湾媒体中，唯一以「环境」为报导主题的新闻性节目，也是公共电视开播以来历史最久的新闻性节目，这十五年「我们的岛」制作

programme.title: 下课花路米第1374集
programme.desc: 针对小学中、高学年生所设计的探索型儿童节目。为了唤起孩子们对台湾的乡土关怀，节目以「生活台语」和「城乡探索」为主轴，穿插逗趣幽默的故事情节，以轻松的方式带领孩子了解台湾的历史、人文、文化。

programme.title: 酷狗宝贝-引鹅入室第1集
programme.desc: 故事描述发明家华力士因缺钱租房，引来一只伪装成房客的危险企鹅费瑟斯，企鹅利用「自动机械裤」计划窃取钻石，忠犬阿高发现后展开智斗。

programme.title: 妈，告诉我哪里有光第1集
programme.desc: 看似平淡无奇的日常生活,不论是吃饭、睡觉、滑手机；或是走路、跑步、看电视，在耳聪目明的正常人感觉里，就像呼吸一样轻松自然。尤其对本剧主角宇帆，一个热情阳光的大三男孩子而言，每天的生活，就是无忧无虑的挥洒他的无敌青春，举手投足、一颦一笑，好似这璀璨的生命就该如此肆意挥霍。直到一场意外，一场不在他算计内的车祸，夺走了阳光男孩的视力，让他的世界从一片光明陷落到无边际的黑暗，从此不仅宇帆绝望痛苦，爱他的父母、师长、朋友、同学，也像跌落深渊一样手足无措。几经波折，宇帆终于在盲人棒球的领域里，找到生命的「另一扇窗」，让他重新拥有欢笑与希望，也让他周围的亲朋好友，再度拥有「正常」的生活。

programme.title: 真情部落格第751集
programme.desc: 自2005年开播以来，《真情部落格》已访问数百位生命勇士。当这些勇士面对生命中的困难时，他们选择依靠对耶稣的信心，勇敢地克服挑战。这些可爱的基督徒愿意与大家分享他们生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是将来自天上的美好福分带给人们。每一个充满血泪的生命见证都是令人震撼的转变，带来最深刻的真实感。

programme.title: 生命真道之丰盛人生第458集
programme.desc: 基督徒必看的节目。它的系列节目叫做「生命真道」，每周一播出。在这个节目中，我们邀请了来自国内外的讲员，他们通过深入的教义解释和精辟的信息，向教友们传达神的信息。

programme.title: 生命的触动第143集
programme.desc: 在像查尔斯史丹利牧师等知名事工或牧师的引领下，我们将带领教友深入浅出地导读圣经。他们以清晰的言辞，引用圣经中的智慧，传达上帝的启示。透过这样的教导，我们希望教友能更深入地了解圣经，并将其应用到生活中。

programme.title: 神选之人第9集
programme.desc: 本剧以精湛的演技与紧凑无冷场的剧情吸引全球观众目光，成功掀起追剧热潮并赢得广大口碑。透过沉浸式的叙事手法，带领观众走进圣经时代的场景与人物互动，同时呈现一位真实、贴近且富有人性光辉的耶稣，使人们在观赏故事的过程中获得全新的理解与感动。

programme.title: Kari Snruwan纪时光新春特辑第2集
programme.desc: 带你踏上充满魅力的兰屿岛，深入了解雅美（达悟）族独特的文化传统。 你知道吗？当长子诞生，父母与祖父母都必须改名，这不仅是一项命名规则，更是对家族传承的尊重与延续。节目中，我们将跟随耆老的脚步，聆听他们故事传递的生活智慧，从出海捕鱼到追踪山猪，学习在大自然中生活的哲理，一起感受随兴自然的岛屿节奏，邀你一同感受岛屿文化的纯粹与感动。

programme.title: ila跟土地学做饭第4季:第43集
programme.desc: 邀请来各行各业顶尖职人走进部落，结合职人专业与部落族人生活经验，一起合奏出知识性、文化性、独特性的部落料理。

programme.title: 树人大冒险第1集
programme.desc: 尤玛想去市集欣赏漂亮的首饰，但是哥哥尤命顾虑她的安危，严格禁止她乱跑。被限制行动的妹妹非常生气，甚至用力咬了哥哥一口，甩开哥哥跑进了森林里的山洞。尤玛和尤命进入了树人世界，而这次哥哥尤命却被魔法命中，变成了「树人」！忧心的妹妹只好担起拯救哥哥的责任，踏上异世界的惊奇之旅！为了让哥哥恢复原状，他们必须从「铁锯魔」手中拯救「花精公主」；在这趟冒险的旅程，尤玛也将深深了解哥哥对自己的爱。

programme.title: hata la!异世界第1集
programme.desc: 是一个以「走出部落、探索世界」为核心概念的文化体验型节目，名称中的「Hata la」来自泰雅族语，意为「出发吧」，象征踏上旅程、认识不同文化。

programme.title: kakudan时光机第9季:第92集
programme.desc: Kakudan为台湾原住民排湾语，「文化，惯习」的意思，希望可以从台湾原住民族隽永的文化，找到实践的道路。台湾原住民族在这块土地上已生活了八千年，祖先留下了珍贵的文化资产与族群智慧。惟因过去的历史面对不同时代的迁徙汉化与日治时期殖民政权的干扰，使得原住民传统文化的存续面临断层与式微的挑战。然而处于文化逐渐式微的困境，又面对长者生命的迅速凋零，我们如何抢救文化？如何教育下一代有正确的文化知识与视野？如何把传统说得更清楚？

programme.title: 大自然生趣第14集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍

programme.desc: 圆福生命礼仪集团，是殡葬业在国内排名第三的企业，在竞争激烈、长时间工作劳累、人员流失严重的情况下，招聘了一批已有丙级执照的新人，希望尽速培养出在第一线工作的礼仪师，能在全省竞争激烈的殡仪市场中，取得领先地位。这一批分发到圆福生命三处的新人中，最受瞩目的是晓恩，她能说善道肯学耐操还仗义执言，只是仗义执言这项专才并不合适礼仪师这个职业；第一天上班就与家属起了冲突，让晓恩的直属长官红牌礼仪师阿圣头痛不已，两人就此冲突不断；心高气傲的晓恩，即使与同事不对盘、被长官痛责、对酗酒的父亲失望，对这个行业也没自己想像中的热诚，但为了家计，决定咬牙做下去！

programme.title: 伯公您好「神」第1集

programme.title: 福气来了(南方篇)第24集

programme.title: 一家之煮第456集

programme.title: 学学嘴学学鼻MV时间第1集

programme.title: 大厨荷西全家游西班牙第1季:第5集

programme.title: 亚洲房屋猎人第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 马来西亚的亚文和玲要找一栋新房子，由于家族人多这个五口之家需要可以容纳十口人以上的房子。亚文和玲能否找到梦想中的房子，有足够的房间来容纳他们的大家族？

programme.title: 风城改造专家第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 本周艾莉森和唐纳文将迎接从业以来最大规模的改造计划：一间位在芝加哥威克公园旁，历史街道上的地标房屋。先花几个月解决了二楼占屋者及地标局审核等问题，再设法保留房屋正面砖墙和飞簷。将房子往后和往下延伸增加建筑面积，融合新旧、古典和现代化元素，打造出带有浓厚芝加哥风情，价值两百万的宽敞独栋住宅。

programme.title: 跟著艾琳去流浪第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 冬季来临，秘境厨房暂停营业。艾琳与老公麦可来到路易斯安纳州深入了解在地人的家乡味，从中找到灵感。

programme.title: 造美宅好扎根第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 退休的消防员凯文带著一家人从俄克拉荷马州搬到克里德。他们接手了长辈的度假房屋，打算就此定居。

programme.title: 豪华原木屋第4季:第5集
programme.desc: 一直环游世界的戴文转型成在家经营自己的生意后，决定在维吉尼亚州购买原木屋定居，并请来好友帕丽和凯文帮忙看房。

programme.title: 豪华原木屋第4季:第6集
programme.desc: 戴尔和苏珊多年来常到明尼苏达州度假，现在他们决定在这里的湖畔买一间度假木屋，离亲朋好友更近。

programme.title: 重量级姊妹第5季:第7集
programme.desc: 潭美与艾美、亚曼达分别起冲突，迟迟未和好，但这时全家人决定去英国来趟寻根之旅，认识家族的历史。

programme.title: 动物求生策略第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 动物能利用独特的繁殖策略，为自己的族群留下更强大的后代。

programme.title: 动物求生策略第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 繁殖是决定生存与灭绝的关键，动物为获得交配机会相互竞争。

programme.title: 动物求生高手第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 介绍自然界最坚忍不拔的前20名动物，见识牠们如何善用攻守策略打击对手、抵御敌人。

programme.title: 动物求生高手第2季:第2集
programme.desc: 倒数揭晓地球上最强的水生动物，看自然界有哪些顶尖的水中蛟龙。

programme.title: 动物求生高手第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集介绍自然界绝顶聪明神乎其技的动物，从聪明的鸟类，到会解决问题的灵长类，每个物种都精通自己独到的生存策略，且看牠们如何动脑赢得竞争。

programme.title: 了不起的非洲动物第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 每年，数百万只动物迁徙穿越壮阔的非洲大草原：感受牛羚如雷奔腾的蹄声，聆听大象低沉的鸣叫，见识猎豹与花豹疾速出击的瞬间，再与鬣狗在荒野嚎叫，陪伴狮群一起漫步，跟随秃鹫乘著热气流翱翔。然而，在这片看似熟悉的野性世界背后，残酷的现实鲜少被看见：90%的猎豹幼崽无法存活到成年，某些秃鹫物种仅剩不到20对繁殖个体。节目深入揭示这些族群所面临的生存威胁，同时展现动物惊人的适应能力与动人故事，看牠们如何在严酷环境中进化、求生，甚至改变自己所栖息的周遭。

programme.title: 珍奇大自然第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 在塞伦盖提，竞争的本质就是狩猎，为了铲除未来的竞争者，这些动物的生活其实就是一场永无止境的竞争。

programme.title: 珍奇大自然第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 能从竞争敌手的手上抢到食物，就不用做狩猎这件苦差事，在塞伦盖提的草原上，常常可以见到抢夺猎物的戏码。

programme.title: 蛇的秘密世界第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 牠们是顶尖猎人、终极生存者，也是长久以来被误解的掠食者。跟著节目揭开蛇的秘密世界，踏上一段精彩旅程，探索蛇类多样的栖息地、非凡的适应能力，以及牠们与人类之间错综复杂的关系。迅速致命的伪装大师，蛇类是地表上最令人畏惧的生物之一，每年造成超过十万人死亡。然而，这些被贴标签成危害人命的掠食者，其实往往是人类侵占栖地的受害者，也因此才引发一连串危险而难解的冲突。《蛇的秘密世界》带领观众深入蛇类不为人知的一面，揭露牠们令人震撼的生存策略。

programme.title: 捕蛇专家第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 茱莉亚贝克想证明女人也可以是捕蛇专家，在这个拟眼镜蛇出没的地方，勇敢的茱莉亚对捕蛇事业怀抱满满的热情。

programme.title: 成群的杀手
programme.desc: 由于人类侵入自然栖地和全球暖化，很多动物的习性会因此而改变，有些危险的动物会大批聚集。

programme.title: 大猫日志新篇章第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 沼泽狮群的母狮们今天遇上了牠们最害怕的情况，就在战斗雄狮跑去别地方的时候，沼泽区竟然来了两只流浪的公狮，威胁小狮子的生存。

programme.title: 野地刺客第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 动物的双颚可能是牠们最要命的武器，有些动物的咬合力能达到惊人的一千多公斤。从赤道的热带雨林到北极的冰封平原，都有咬合力惊人的掠食者。

programme.title: 了不起的非洲动物第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 每年，数百万只动物迁徙穿越壮阔的非洲大草原：感受牛羚如雷奔腾的蹄声，聆听大象低沉的鸣叫，见识猎豹与花豹疾速出击的瞬间，再与鬣狗在荒野嚎叫，陪伴狮群一起漫步，跟随秃鹫乘著热气流翱翔。然而，在这片看似熟悉的野性世界背后，残酷的现实鲜少被看见：90%的猎豹幼崽无法存活到成年，某些秃鹫物种仅剩不到20对繁殖个体。节目深入揭示这些族群所面临的生存威胁，同时展现动物惊人的适应能力与动人故事，看牠们如何在严酷环境中进化、求生，甚至改变自己所栖息的周遭。

programme.title: 珍奇大自然第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 在塞伦盖提，竞争的本质就是狩猎，为了铲除未来的竞争者，这些动物的生活其实就是一场永无止境的竞争。

programme.title: 乔治亚水族馆第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 乔治亚水族馆原本有三只白鲸，馆方分别从德州与佛罗达州再引进一公一母的白鲸，组成更紧密的白鲸群。

programme.title: 动物求生高手第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 揭晓野地里的最强爸妈，探究奇妙的育儿技巧和繁殖策略。

programme.title: 热血兽医师第5季:第1集
programme.desc: 杰克是一只约一岁大的流浪猫。从牠脖子上的项圈看来，牠一定也是只曾受到主人呵护的小猫。牠可能是在很小的时候就离家出走，或遭到弃养。因此牠独自游荡有一段时间了，随著牠不断长大，项圈也慢慢嵌入牠的脖子，造成一整圈受到感染的伤口。兽医很惊讶杰克在这种情况下还能活著，如果牠在长大一点，那牠很可能会被勒死。在医疗团队的细心治疗和照顾后，杰克的颈伤终于康复了。诊所员工发现杰克虽然曾流浪很久，但并不是一只野性难驯的猫，因此他们也为牠找到很有爱心的领养者。

programme.title: 汪星人的故事第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 介绍狗从野生掠食者转变成为人驯化、甚至备受宠爱的过程。

programme.title: 爱心动物农场第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 芝加哥动物照管中心有一批斗鸡有待认养，谷仓收容所预定协助认养一只，结果带回两只—汉弥尔顿与史特劳斯—以及一只白狗温特。丹到克莉丝汀当志工的动物收容所认养回两只小兔子—帕可与诺瓦—作为自己的宠物。因为他租的公寓不得养动物，所以他只好另觅新居，刚好弟弟克里斯不堪农场公鸡一大清早叫他起床，于是和丹当起室友。小牛迪杰长大了，不适合与小动物待在一起，改搬去大牛的牧草地。迪杰的好哥们—盲眼牛麦克—很思念牠，丹让麦克到大牧草地与迪杰相会，没想到麦克竟能适应与大牛在一起。谷仓农场打算兴建新猪舍，为现有的猪提供更大空间，还能收容更多只猪。

programme.title: 珍奇大自然第1季:第10集
programme.desc: 塞伦盖提的大兽群踏上迁徙的旅程，途中地形跟掠食者可能夺去牠们的性命，但是牠们必须踏上已有千年历史的迁徙之路，抵达丰美的草地。

programme.title: 动物情深第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 芮伊哈维是一位野生动物保护志工。她在五十岁之前曾是乐团经理和活动发起人，但她的后半生和前半生却大不相同。她在退休后成了一所野生动物中心的志工，因此喜欢上袋鼠，并建立了自己的袋鼠庇护所。在二０一九年的澳洲丛林大火中，她的庇护所被烧毁了，收容的袋鼠也都失散了。后来有只名叫康酷的袋鼠回来了，牠还通知其他幸存的袋鼠来此避难。在袋鼠和芮伊的合作下，这些幸存的袋鼠终于能在此安心养伤。后来芮伊也重建了一座更新更好的庇护所。

programme.title: 动物求生策略第1季:第1集

programme.title: 超级蝙蝠车第77集
programme.desc: 蝙蝠侠、罗宾以及蝙蝠女孩因一起阴谋而离开蝙蝠洞，蝙蝠电脑于是将她的主机板复制到蝙蝠车上，赋予它们「生命」。刚诞生的「超级蝙蝠车」随即展开保卫已曝光的蝙蝠洞，及对抗邪恶敌人「 the Legion of Zoom!」的重大任务。跟著令人惊叹的超级车队一同前行，看剧中帅气的班姆、小碧、红鸟、巴夫，和蝙蝠飞翼是如何帮助蝙蝠侠、蝙蝠女孩和罗宾，一同守护高谭市的安全。纵使面对「Legion of Zoom」，或是其他高谭市恶名昭彰的超级反派，超级蝙蝠车都将使用他们令人难以置信的小装置和创意的团队合作来拯救这一天。

programme.title: 汤姆猫与杰利鼠第104集
programme.desc: 汤姆猫和杰利鼠的主人要搬家了，牠们成了无家可归的流浪汉，遇到了伤心的小女孩罗比，她的监护人菲格姨妈是一个坏心肠的女人，企图侵吞罗比爸爸留下的亿万财产。罗比逃出后，菲格姨妈为了抓到罗比，还想出了悬赏百万捉拿的诡计。还好罗比的爸爸赶了回来，菲格姨妈的阴谋破灭，而汤姆和杰瑞也有了更大更漂亮的房子，只是牠们之间的战争可没那么容易就结束呢！

programme.title: 豆豆先生第448集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 少年悍将 Go第10集
programme.desc: 《少年悍将！GO》是2013年卡通频道和华纳制作的卡通电视节目。也是DC系列《少年悍将》漫画的改编卡通，跟前作不同点在于，本作画法以萌系画风呈现，更大的特点是它著重在喜剧效果上，没有前作的黑暗、严肃气氛，剧中多围绕在少年悍将们的平时生活。本做最大的看点是制作组将许多DC的人物做为背景角色呈现。

programme.title: 爱烦多王子冒险中第9集

programme.title: 天兵公园第5集

programme.title: 豆豆先生第37集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 摇滚吧！宝贝第201集
programme.desc: 音乐是一种世界语言，当你在一个语言不通的地方，拿起乐器来哼唱几句，就能快速连结彼此的心。对于正处于语言能力疾速发展的儿童，接触音乐更能和 语言学习相辅相成。已有多项研究证明，让发育中的幼儿接触乐器，可以刺激脑部神经，增进创造力，加强耐心及专注力。

programme.title: 熊熊遇见你第28集
programme.desc: 这是一部超适合全家观赏的冒险幽默喜剧、充满热情搞笑的原创力和想像力！故事描述三只熊熊兄弟大大、胖达、阿极非常积极想融入人类的世界，但又频频凸槌。个性完全不同的三只熊感情超好！大大乐观外向很敢冲、胖达感情丰富爱幻想、阿极特立独行超特别。由于他们爱玩手机梦想在网路爆红也常闹出不少笑话，这让故事时时充满惊喜，看过很快就上瘾！

programme.desc: 《BEN10：再显神威》剧情回到十岁男孩田小班意外地发现外星手表Omnitrix的起点，这神奇的手表竟然可以让原本平凡的小班拥有变身成外星英雄的能力！更厉害的是，每一个外星英雄都有独特又酷炫的超能力！小班、小玟和马克爷爷祖孙三人一起踏上冒险旅程，打击外星坏蛋！但小班身负更大的责任，就是千万不可以变错外星英雄、用错超能力，才能所向无敌！

programme.title: 宝贝乐一通第19集
programme.desc: 在成为叛逆无礼的经典乐一通动画短片前，兔宝宝、太菲鸭和死党们都还是刚学走路的小小孩，天真无邪的好奇宝宝。 特别为学龄前儿童设计的宝贝乐一通将为卡通迷们隆重介绍这些可爱讨喜的小小明星；节目将以较小体型、甜蜜讨喜的方式呈现无比欢乐的经典卡通明星。兔宝宝、太菲鸭、傻大鸟、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充满冒险行动的维多利亚式宅第中，可是一群鬼灵精怪的小捣蛋鬼。 小兔宝宝和朋友们将邀请所有小小卡通迷，探索这个无奇不有的欢乐世界。

programme.title: 兔巴哥大工程小短片第1012集
programme.desc: 在艾克米建筑公司，兔巴哥跟萝拉兔带领一群建筑师，坦白说，他们都不应该靠近任何建筑工地，但是，他们像团队一样合作，太菲鸭、猪小弟、崔弟还有其他伙伴，用他们的工具跟工程车完成许多史上最疯狂的工程。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第57集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第55集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 碰碰红绿豆第5集

programme.title: 泡泡孔雀鱼第67集
programme.desc: 这是一个集音乐、舞蹈、娱乐为一体的儿童动画。讲述的是一群学龄前儿童在水下城市Bubbletucky中的各种经历。透过广泛的节目主题设定，以及多元具活力及启发性的水族教室，让学龄前小朋友们和节目里茉莉、吉儿和她们的鱼同学们，在音乐和欢笑里学习科学、数学、文学，一起探索及认识世界。

programme.title: 汪汪队立大功-汪汪喵喵救援队第1集
programme.desc: 汪汪队是由一群勇敢的狗狗组成，并由机智勇敢的莱德担任队长。 镇上居民只要遇到困难，第一时间就会呼叫汪汪队来救援， 可靠的莱德队长与汪汪队，也一定会不负众望完成任务。

programme.title: momo mini亲子电影院第98集
programme.desc: 超吸睛的精选国内外儿少影展短片，让大朋友小朋友在电影中一起欢笑一起思考

programme.title: 霸王龙雷奇第14集
programme.desc: 这是一个关于亲情、友情、勇气和爱的故事。很久很久以前，有一只特别的霸王龙，他叫雷奇。在尚未孵化的时候，雷奇就被一只雌性慈母龙捡回家，成为食草恐龙家庭的一员。身为食肉恐龙的他，有捕食者的本能，但妈妈的细心教导让他明白，不能伤害他人，所以他努力克制，成为了一只外表凶猛，但心地善良的霸王龙。在与家人、朋友、邻居们的相处中，雷奇和他的性格各异的恐龙小伙伴们相互理解、相互陪伴，体会到了亲情、友情的温暖，学会了勇敢和爱，一起快乐生活，慢慢长大。

programme.title: 妖果小学第18集
programme.desc: 水果奶奶化身为动画人物，融合妖怪力量和台湾水果元素，创造出迥然不同的人类与妖怪如何理解对方，如何相拥彼此，以及携手面对困境的奇幻冒险故事。

programme.title: 小王子和朋友们第106集
programme.desc: 小王子要和我们地球的两位小朋友 – 夏洛特和以利亚，一起搭著B612号太空船到外太空去旅行。当然同行的还有人工智慧小玫瑰，以及工程师小狐狸，他们将要一同探索宇宙和其他星球上的居民，结交新朋友，并利用他们在地球上的经验，克服各种类似的困难，一边学习一边玩乐，一起展开惊人的大冒险！

programme.title: 电影蜡笔小新-我们的恐龙日记第1集
programme.desc: 这个暑假，好像有点不一样哦！这个暑假，主打近距离观察复活的恐龙的主题乐园「恐龙岛」在东京开幕了。小新与春日部防卫队，受邀至这座备受瞩目的乐园参观。与此同时，野原家的爱犬小白，在春日部河畔遇见了小恐龙那那。那那很快地与他们成为好友，共度这个充满回忆的暑假。然而，那那其实有一个惊人的秘密。就在此时，「恐龙岛」上发生了恐龙逃脱事件……。

programme.title: 真珠美人鱼第5集

programme.desc: 北太平洋美人鱼公主露亚为找回失落的真珠来到人间，并与人类少年堂本海斗相恋的故事。 同时，她必须联合七大洋的美人鱼公主们，利用歌声的力量对抗企图征服海洋的邪恶势力，并揭开海斗隐藏的重大秘密。

programme.desc: 柯南一行人参观位于西多摩市境内即将完成的全日本最高双塔摩天大楼。此时在这摩天大楼里却出现了多位与此建筑物有著不同关系的人士！ 不久之后第一个杀人事件发生了…。 令人不敢相信的是《黑暗组织》的成员竟然同时也在大楼附近出现， 而柯南的真正身份会被那些家伙发现吗？且灰原哀真正的身份又是？柯南将与其宿敌─《黑色组织》展开一场史上最恐怖的攻防战…

programme.title: 动物大明星第2季:第13集
programme.desc: 逛完一趟动物园 爸爸：小宝，今天你认识了几种动物呢？ 小宝：好多好多喔！有大象、狮子、老虎、还有红毛猩猩... 不过为什么猴子的屁股会这么红啊？ 为什么无尾熊要睡在树上呢？ 为什么长颈鹿不坐下来休息呢？ 为什么猫头鹰的脖子可以转270度呢？为什么…为什么…为什么… 小宝的一百个疑问，谁来解答呢？ 「 动物园大明星」是专为小朋友打造的动物节目，写实记录各种动 物生态，看动物褓母怎么照顾牠们的生活起居 带小朋友进入不一样的动物世界，开启他们广阔的视野。

programme.title: 熊熊波西第1集

programme.title: 霸王龙雷奇第4集
programme.desc: 这是一个关于亲情、友情、勇气和爱的故事。很久很久以前，有一只特别的霸王龙，他叫雷奇。在尚未孵化的时候，雷奇就被一只雌性慈母龙捡回家，成为食草恐龙家庭的一员。身为食肉恐龙的他，有捕食者的本能，但妈妈的细心教导让他明白，不能伤害他人，所以他努力克制，成为了一只外表凶猛，但心地善良的霸王龙。在与家人、朋友、邻居们的相处中，雷奇和他的性格各异的恐龙小伙伴们相互理解、相互陪伴，体会到了亲情、友情的温暖，学会了勇敢和爱，一起快乐生活，慢慢长大。

programme.title: 泡泡孔雀鱼第70集
programme.desc: 这是一个集音乐、舞蹈、娱乐为一体的儿童动画。讲述的是一群学龄前儿童在水下城市Bubbletucky中的各种经历。透过广泛的节目主题设定，以及多元具活力及启发性的水族教室，让学龄前小朋友们和节目里茉莉、吉儿和她们的鱼同学们，在音乐和欢笑里学习科学、数学、文学，一起探索及认识世界。

programme.desc: 由5位朋友凯特、妮娜、巴席、皮吉、狄诺组成的游戏收集队！在宇宙中的各个星球旅行，找寻朋友和乐趣，收集各种新游戏和每个人分享，一起跟著游戏收集队踏上探索奇妙星球的星际之旅吧！

programme.title: Pororo与朋友们-病毒克星第1集
programme.desc: 「PORORO」和他的朋友们对抗可怕的病毒并拯救小镇！ 有一天，Pororo发现他玩的游戏中出现了病毒怪物的入侵他的平板电脑。不久之后，Pororo得知病毒是如何传播到现实世界的。与此同时，一直在努力研发疫苗的艾迪进入游戏世界拯救小镇，却发现自己忘了带疫苗。得知这一点后，Pororo在现实世界中与可怕的病毒斗争，并找寻方法帮助艾迪，他们能够战胜病毒并保护众人吗？

programme.title: 八戒-决战未来第1集
programme.desc: 将《西游记》搬到科幻场景，八戒化身赛博胖客，与理工男三藏、火爆护卫悟空、女机器人小净，穿梭新旧混杂市景，探索幸福真谛。

programme.title: 电影蜡笔小新-我们的恐龙日记第1集
programme.desc: 这个暑假，好像有点不一样哦！这个暑假，主打近距离观察复活的恐龙的主题乐园「恐龙岛」在东京开幕了。小新与春日部防卫队，受邀至这座备受瞩目的乐园参观。与此同时，野原家的爱犬小白，在春日部河畔遇见了小恐龙那那。那那很快地与他们成为好友，共度这个充满回忆的暑假。然而，那那其实有一个惊人的秘密。就在此时，「恐龙岛」上发生了恐龙逃脱事件……。

programme.title: 活了100天的鳄鱼第1集
programme.desc: 在樱花盛开的3月，大家约好要一起赏樱，却迟迟看不见鳄鱼的身影。担心鳄鱼的老鼠将樱花的照片传给伙伴们，却显示在鳄鱼掉在路上且萤幕破裂的手机画面中。到赏花日为止的100天内，鳄鱼过著再平凡不过的生活。赏花日的100天后，樱花树上长出绿苗，鳄鱼的好友们无法面对与鳄鱼之间的回忆，彼此渐渐失去了联系……。

programme.title: 玛莎与熊第3集
programme.desc: 玛莎是个充满朝气、活力四射的小女孩，住在离森林不远的小木屋里。有天意外地闯进住在森林的熊熊家，开始了充满欢笑与奇妙的生活。从马戏团退休的熊熊，在森林里度过了安稳平淡的退休生活，直到遇到了玛莎，为他的生活增添了许多乐趣，从一开始害怕玛莎的调皮捣蛋，到逐渐他们成为了最棒的朋友。在他们的生活里充满著玛莎的好奇心与熊熊对玛莎悉心的教导与照顾。 「玛莎与熊」来自于俄罗斯的3D动画，故事内容源自于俄罗斯的童话，在俄罗斯受到了大朋友与小朋友的欢迎，故事搬到现代的大萤幕中，更增添了许多冒险故事。动画中所呈现的音乐与内容都有著浓浓的俄罗斯风情，并透过立体3D的呈现方式带来了视觉与听觉上的飨宴。 「玛莎与熊」以轻

programme.title: 魔法咪路咪路第89集
programme.desc: 刚升上国中二年级的小枫，一直盼望能与仰慕已久的结木摄两情相悦。某日小枫买了一个可以实现爱情愿望的马克杯，召唤出小精灵咪路，但是个性别扭的咪路不肯为小枫施展魔法，虽然小枫极力想讨好咪路，但咪路仍以『讨厌依赖魔法的人类』为由拒绝帮助小枫。小枫只得自行努力对结木摄展开攻势，但是…

programme.title: 真珠美人鱼第1集
programme.desc: 北太平洋美人鱼公主露亚为找回失落的真珠来到人间，并与人类少年堂本海斗相恋的故事。 同时，她必须联合七大洋的美人鱼公主们，利用歌声的力量对抗企图征服海洋的邪恶势力，并揭开海斗隐藏的重大秘密。

programme.title: 名侦探柯南-第11位前锋第1集
programme.desc: 大规模爆炸的预告电话！这并不是游戏，也绝非虚张声势。 要阻止接下来的爆炸只有一个办法，就是解开犯人留下的谜样的暗号！ J联赛的10个足球馆已被装上了炸弹， 犯人所说的解除炸弹的方式究竟是什么？ 柯南的推理中的致命失误！使小兰危在旦夕！ 4分钟，对前锋的考验。 4分钟，决定上万人的生死！ 最后的15秒，奇迹，会发生吗？

programme.title: 宝可梦地平线-系列第81集
programme.desc: 在广大的宝可梦世界的舞台上，莉可与罗伊的全新冒险即将开启！持有神秘坠饰，来自帕底亚的少女：莉可。持有谜之精灵球，来自关都的少年：罗伊。等待他们的邂逅将会是什么，他们命运又会如何?!这是一个透过冒险去「寻找」某些重要东西的故事。

programme.title: YOYO好好玩第4集

programme.title: POLI第3集
programme.desc: 在美丽的布鲁姆斯小镇，有一群救援小英雄，分别是富有正义感的警车队长-波力、勇敢又可靠消防车-罗伊、善良又聪明的救护车-安宝以及反应敏捷的直升机-赫利。为保护小镇居民的安全，英勇的救援小队将同心协力克服困难与危险帮助朋友们！跟著波力一起出发去救援吧！当朋友有需要帮助的时候，救援小队就会适时地出现，用团队合作及智慧来解决困难。小朋友能从救援小队帮助别人的行动中，学习日常生活中应该如何小心防范周遭事物，也从中学习到助人为快乐之本的道理以及和平的与他人共处的重要性，是放心让孩子收看之优质动画。

programme.title: 名侦探光之美少女第2集
programme.desc: 明智安娜是住在真心未来镇的14岁国中二年级生！在生日那天出现的精灵包包，以及房间里的项链引导下，她从2027年穿越时空来到1999年的真心未来市，她在那里遇见了向往成为名侦探的14岁少女小林未来！ 就在这时，事件发生了！？似乎有人因为重要的东西被偷走而伤透脑筋… 犯案的是幻影怪盗团 ！ 无法对需要帮助的人视而不见……！安娜与未来抱著这样的想法，变身成【名侦探光之美少女】。 名侦探光之美少女将用推理守护大家的笑容。「这个谜团，就靠天使破案！」而安娜是否能回到原本的时代呢……！？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主第20集

programme.title: 蜡笔小新-新次元!超能力大决战~飞吧!手卷寿司~第1集
programme.desc: 某天晚上，从宇宙飞来的黑光和白光接近日本列岛，落在埼玉县春日部市的一处非常普通的民宅。跟往常一样，满心期待晚餐快点做好的小新被那道白光击中，体内涌现不可思议的力量。「屁屁…屁屁好烫…！？」小新把身体交给力量，注意力集中在屁屁后，玩具就开始在半空中飘浮。「这个，实在太厉害了……。」另一边，有个男人被黑光照到，得到超能力后开始大肆破坏，他的愿望是摧毁世界。破坏、混乱、惨叫声，在全日本都被恐惧支配的此时此刻，小新挺身而战！

programme.title: 宝贝老板第1集
programme.desc: 万千宠爱集一身的提姆在父母带回婴儿弟弟时，瞬间变成家中二等公民！提姆对这个西装笔挺的诡异婴儿充满忌妒与怀疑，还发现他不但自称老板，更与邻居的婴儿们一起「开会」！在意外导致提姆遭禁足后，愧疚的宝贝老板决定带他参观宝贝公司…

programme.title: 黑猫鲁道夫第1集
programme.desc: 全球热卖100万本的日本畅销国民童书，首度改编而成的动画剧场版；井上真央、铃木亮平携手合作耍「萌」献声，与《神奇宝贝》《妖怪手表》剧场版动画团队，倾心打造家喻户晓的猫咪流浪奇遇记。故事描述，黑猫鲁道夫与最爱的主人理惠住在一起，某天牠为了逃离鱼店老板的追打而意外跳上长途货车，不知不觉来到了大都会-东京。 牠在那里邂逅了让所有猫都畏惧、看得懂人类文字的街猫老大可多乐。找不到回家方向的鲁道夫，只能跟著深谙街头生存之道的可多乐，展开一段流浪猫的冒险生活…。究竟鲁道夫能不能回到理惠的怀抱呢？可多乐又隐瞒了什么不为人知的秘密？邀请大家跟著这群流浪猫们，一同探寻这个危机四伏的人类世界，尽情畅游在温暖动人的萌

programme.title: 假面骑士ZEZTZ第28集
programme.desc: 主角万津莫，与妹妹万津美浪同住。莫拥有一项特别的才能—能够自行选择想做的梦，并在梦中依照自己的意志行动，就是所谓的「清晰梦」。他每晚都在梦里化身无敌特务，尽情活跃。某天，他在梦中得到了一条变身腰带，化身为假面骑士！成为假面骑士后的他，还获得了潜入他人梦境的能力。此时，世界出现了会寄生在人类梦境中的恶梦使者，从梦境侵略至现实世界。万津莫担负起守护人类 真实与梦境的战士——假面骑士ZEZTZ，正式诞生！

programme.desc: (2011)超能力花妈出击，拯救世界，维护和平?!被骤雷打到的花妈，意外得到超能力！本来家事做得普普、料理能力乏善可陈的花妈，突然变得十八般武艺兼具；打扫、洗衣、料理手艺，样样完美无可挑剔！渐渐地，花妈认为自己的超能力不该只用在家里，便暪著家人成为了「超级花妈」，四处去帮忙需要援助的人，更成为维护正义的宇宙超级英雄…？！

programme.title: 蜡笔小新-幽灵忍者珍风传第1集
programme.desc: 《蜡笔小新》的30周年之作。以小新的身世为主题，开启的忍者冒险故事。原本小新和家人一起过著刺激又和平的日常，某天，一名自称「屁祖隐千代女」的女性造访了野原家，还带来了一个爆炸性的消息，她说自己才是新之助真正的母亲，小新其实并不是野原家的小孩？同时她身边带著一位名叫「珍藏」的5岁少年。当天晚上，千代女与珍藏留宿在野原家中，但是某个不知名的忍者军团却袭击了野原家，这才爆出「千代女」的真实身份，是一名从忍者村逃脱的女忍者，忍者军团追捕她的同时，认为小新就是千代女的儿子，两人就这么一起被抓走！同时在忍者村里，屁祖隐家以代代相传的「幽灵之术」守护著封印地球能量的「地球肚脐」，假如地球肚脐的能量外泄，地球

programme.title: 神偷奶爸3第1集
programme.desc: 《神偷奶爸》，2010年喜剧3D动画片，是神偷奶爸系列电影的首部作品，由环球影业及照明娱乐制作，首部两家合作的电脑动画电影。讲述神偷格鲁项目利用三个孤儿女作为他伟大偷月项目的棋子，直到发现她们天真的爱深刻地改变他。该片由《冰川时代》、《霍顿与无名氏》监制克里斯梅勒丹德利制作；导演是曾入围奥斯卡动画短片奖《松鼠、坚果和时间机器》的克里斯雷纳德，以及皮尔考芬共同执导。

programme.title: 神偷奶爸小小兵第1集
programme.desc: 《神偷奶爸》：做坏事做上瘾的世界级大坏蛋格鲁，坐拥各种最先进的科技产品，一发起狠来，更会使用缩小光、冷冻光和陆空战车，来消灭阻止他偷月亮计划的人。有天突然来了三个活泼可爱的孤儿，搞得他手足无措，眼看他策画已久的偷月计划即将展开，他们会擦出什么样的火花？计划能成功吗？还是格鲁会变成超级奶爸呢？《小小兵》：盘古开天时期是一个黄色的有机体，随著时间演化成小小兵团，他们的存在目的就是要服侍当代最凶恶的主人，然而从恐龙、埃及法老王、拿破仑甚至是德古拉，小小兵总是不停的失败，最后发现已经没有可以服侍的主人，从此开始郁郁寡欢，逐渐凋零。其中的一只小小兵—凯文有个伟大的计划，就是带著麻吉—大胃王史都华还有胆小

programme.title: YOYO好好玩第5集

programme.title: POLI第5集
programme.desc: 在美丽的布鲁姆斯小镇，有一群救援小英雄，分别是富有正义感的警车队长-波力、勇敢又可靠消防车-罗伊、善良又聪明的救护车-安宝以及反应敏捷的直升机-赫利。为保护小镇居民的安全，英勇的救援小队将同心协力克服困难与危险帮助朋友们！跟著波力一起出发去救援吧！当朋友有需要帮助的时候，救援小队就会适时地出现，用团队合作及智慧来解决困难。小朋友能从救援小队帮助别人的行动中，学习日常生活中应该如何小心防范周遭事物，也从中学习到助人为快乐之本的道理以及和平的与他人共处的重要性，是放心让孩子收看之优质动画。

programme.title: 百分之一相对论
programme.desc: 「时间是个闭环，在这个只能前进不能后退的时空，只会有一条必然结局，也百分之一百会发生。但是任何的事物都存著误差，小至百分之一的误差都有可能在这完美的闭环上造成巨大的乱流，导致时间线的崩溃。」成员陈汉典、陈零九、潘君仑、梁以辰、宋伟恩和本本是TDIP时空调查局所派遣的时空探员。凭借著他们的智慧、勇气和卓越的危机处理能力，他们肩负使命，要解开这个世界上出现的乱流任务，来还原那百分之一的真相！究竟在充满谜团和未知挑战的时空任务中，探员们要如何运用推理和解谜，还原事件背后的神秘面纱，维持时空的和平呢...

programme.title: 自由的旅行者第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 旅行本身就是一种充满自由的生活方式，带著台湾人勇往直前的精神，透过每一次旅行，站在不同角色的视点；体验不同的文化与生活；拥抱未知的人事物，让台湾与世界来一场国际级的交流，这就是每次旅程中最无可取代的收获。旅行可以是背包客独旅的ME TIME，也可以是踏出舒适圈，探索世界的壮游；更可以是人生观的改变与自我的拓展。只要带著无拘无束的心出发，你就会是个「自由的旅行者」。

programme.title: 世界第一等特辑第5集
programme.desc: 《世界第一等》是台湾八大电视“大视界系列”的一个旅游节目，开播于2005年，该节目风格为探险走向，大部分节目会拜访当地台商及移民，了解当地台商的成功经验及与当地华侨一同探索该国家的文化和传统。《世界第一等》探访世界各地稀奇古怪、骇人听闻的风土民情，首集即报导越南畸形村，创下1点多高收视率，在市场上引起不小震撼。虽然这节目满足观众喜欢“窥视”新奇事务的心理状态，但也借此进行人道关怀。例如首集播出畸形村后，替中华民国红十字会募得新台币一百多万元，制作单位之后也随同中华民国红十字会秘书长郝龙斌至越南捐赠该款项。

programme.title: 健康零距离
programme.desc: 《健康零距离》是兼具知识、新闻、专业与实用性的健康资讯节目，邀集优质中西医师、营养师、体适能专家等黄金阵容，以轻松聊天的方式，让观众无痛吸收健康知识，为大家解惑医疗迷思，打破网路健康谣言。还会教观众运用节令食材制作养生食疗，以及不同主题的健康小运动，现学现做一起顾健康!

programme.title: 百分之一相对论第13集

programme.desc: 以70%以上外景的真正汽车节目，带给大家正确的汽车资讯。

programme.title: 台湾一千零一个故事第625集
programme.desc: 介绍台湾在地食材的故事，也是台湾最深刻的人生故事。故事的主角们，有的为著有机农业奋斗打拼，为这片土地奉献青春与血汗。有的则是经过千百次的调味与尝试，只为了成就一道美味料理。对比著经营者与料理人的故事，他们或是为生活中年转业、或是离乡背井追寻梦想，人生路上各自遭逢百转千折的冲突与适应，才能在逆境中成功蜕变。

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第89集
programme.desc: 2位花甲明星＋2位少年偶像，跨龄差距的结伴青春旅行，走访在地文化行销台湾，世代差异的旅游个性激荡出充满意外性的实境自助旅行。当稚嫩少年遇上犀利花甲，会擦出什么火花呢?这是一段花甲老熟肉与少年小鲜肉们，跨越大龄差距，结伴而行的明星青春旅行。到底小鲜肉们想什么？而老熟肉们又会怎么玩？透过世代差异，激荡出观众意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅游实境节目，纪录跨世代的艺人们难忘的友情之旅！从陌生到熟悉！ 从畏惧到麻吉！让小鲜肉成长！让老熟肉回春！不啰唆！现在出发吧～

programme.title: 理财必修课第37集
programme.desc: 《理财必修课》全新改版！人气KOL联手基金小姐姐，年轻专业、生活理财无所不谈

programme.title: 进击的台湾第82集
programme.desc: 《进击的台湾》以介绍美食、传统产业及农林渔牧业角度切入，著眼于纪录生活在台湾这片土地小人物的人生故事，跟随著进击的台湾的脚步一起来看看，平凡人不平凡的创业轨迹和精神，成功背后令人感动的点点滴滴，以及为梦想奋斗背后的辛勤过程。

programme.title: 似锦第5集
programme.desc: 讲述东平伯府四小姐姜似死在爱人郁锦手中后，重启人生的故事。这一次，姜似勇敢退婚、智斗恶毒婶婶、开设香铺、助好友、查少女连环被害案……一点点将悲剧改写。姜似与少年将军郁锦再度相遇，二人虽各怀心事，却依旧陷入纠缠。姜似与郁锦联手改变了哥哥姜湛落水而亡、姐姐姜依自缢的命运，也改写了父亲被长公主嫁祸斩首的结局。两人共同战胜艰难险阻，姜似对郁锦的态度也在悄悄转变，愿意再与郁锦相爱一次。二人携手维护大周和平，收获一世繁花。

programme.title: 白色强人II第21集
programme.desc: 公营医院龙头明成北医院于院长杨逸滔、副院长唐明统领下，核心部门神经外科、心胸肺科、急症室，谱写著拯救生命的医患故事。当年医疗改革方案失败告终，逸滔并未气馁，倡议《全面开放药物名册草案》，主张为罕见病患者以廉价提供药物，却受到肿瘤科专家叶晴反对，她更空降至明成北出任院长，跟逸滔分庭抗礼。此时，前战地医生李文信加盟明成北团队，联同急症室医生苏怡、神经外科医生吕霭宁等白色强者，将要应对种种危机…

programme.desc: 餐厅的主厨、路边推摊的小车、妈妈桌上的味道、东西料理、时尚美味…，台湾文化揉合了移民社会的多样性，四百年来，五味杂陈。台湾壹百种味道以台湾味为主角，透过节目，呈现每一道台湾菜的滋味与厨师的故事。每集主题不只谈食材的来源、厨师作法的异同，还有更多借由一道道美食，看见每一位美食作手，背后所潜藏的人生故事。观众跟著节目里面的故事，了解台湾美食、历史渊源、多元文化、生活方式以及属于台湾人的情感。

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第182集
programme.desc: 2位花甲明星＋2位少年偶像，跨龄差距的结伴青春旅行，走访在地文化行销台湾，世代差异的旅游个性激荡出充满意外性的实境自助旅行。当稚嫩少年遇上犀利花甲，会擦出什么火花呢?这是一段花甲老熟肉与少年小鲜肉们，跨越大龄差距，结伴而行的明星青春旅行。到底小鲜肉们想什么？而老熟肉们又会怎么玩？透过世代差异，激荡出观众意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅游实境节目，纪录跨世代的艺人们难忘的友情之旅！从陌生到熟悉！ 从畏惧到麻吉！让小鲜肉成长！让老熟肉回春！不啰唆！现在出发吧～

programme.title: 似锦第4集
programme.desc: 讲述东平伯府四小姐姜似死在爱人郁锦手中后，重启人生的故事。这一次，姜似勇敢退婚、智斗恶毒婶婶、开设香铺、助好友、查少女连环被害案……一点点将悲剧改写。姜似与少年将军郁锦再度相遇，二人虽各怀心事，却依旧陷入纠缠。姜似与郁锦联手改变了哥哥姜湛落水而亡、姐姐姜依自缢的命运，也改写了父亲被长公主嫁祸斩首的结局。两人共同战胜艰难险阻，姜似对郁锦的态度也在悄悄转变，愿意再与郁锦相爱一次。二人携手维护大周和平，收获一世繁花。

programme.desc: 天真烂漫的居家购物主持人水晶，梦想成为赢得人心胜于金钱的成功商人。童年时失去父母后，她与技工状元一起游遍全国，成长为坚强勇敢的女性。虽然外表看来凶悍，但实际上她是一个心肠柔软，做事笨拙的爱哭鬼，还是个不敢跟心上人朱旴真对上眼的傻瓜。与此同时，她身边还有总是游手好闲、让她抓狂的吕懿株。他是一位军人，比起同理心更重视逻辑，但喝醉后就会昏睡过去。遇上喝酒如喝水的水晶后，他的颜面扫地，却也开始对她心动。在命运的捉弄下他得知自己是马城集团的二孙子，而他的哥哥正是水晶的暗恋对象旴真。

programme.title: 詹姆士出走料理第338集

programme.title: 大唐攻略第29集
programme.desc: 太平盛世，百姓安居乐业，一片祥和。大将军盛骁靖的长子盛楚慕从小被母亲宠溺，是长安城里有名的纨裤子弟。一次广州府远游中，盛楚慕偶遇绣坊商户家的小姐傅柔，对其倾城之貌一见倾心，誓要抱得美人归。性格刚烈极有主见的傅柔，平生最看不起不学无术之人。盛楚慕佯装成文武双全的好男儿，靠著耍小聪明获得了傅柔的好感。但几次接触之后，傅柔不但对盛楚慕是否真的满腹经纶、武艺高强产生怀疑，还觉得他是个登徒子，不够真诚。盛楚慕为了重新赢得傅柔的尊重，向舅舅讨教兵法之道，最后真从只懂风花雪月的花花公子成长为能文能武的有才之人。误会澄清，脱胎换骨的盛楚慕赢得了傅柔的青睐。

programme.title: 手术直播间第15集
programme.desc: 讲述天才医生郑仁为查多年前的「冤案」来到海城医院，与急诊科主任苏云组成搭档。在一次次抢救生死的过程中，他们不仅面对医学挑战，也揭开医院内部隐藏的黑暗秘密，逐步逼近当年的真相。郑仁用专业治愈病患，苏云则以温暖守护患者与团队，两人共同成长、彼此信任，实现医者初心，也在人性与职业的考验中，找到生命的意义与爱的力量。

programme.title: 如懿传第63集
programme.desc: 公元1735年乾隆继位，与他少年相知的侧福晋如懿也依礼进宫为妃。权力更迭过程中，乾隆与如懿互相扶持，共同渡过难关。乾隆经过多年努力如愿将如懿推到皇后位置。然而如懿却发现，乾隆已成长为成熟帝王，他的多疑善变以及帝王的自私不断显露，两人间的情意信任渐渐破灭。但如懿依旧坚守美好回忆，恪守皇后职责，直到去世。

programme.title: 笑吧东海第68集
programme.desc: 讲述被领养到美国，精神年龄只有九岁的安娜，事隔四十年后和儿子东海回到韩国，为了与儿子的女朋友尹世华相逢，但却意外上了电视节目寻找东海的亲生父亲，最后却寻得失散四十年的父母亲与爱情的故事。

programme.title: 笑吧东海第69集

programme.title: 麻雀变凤凰第52集
programme.desc: 《麻雀变凤凰》是讲述一位在街头贩卖饰品的摊贩郑梦希，因为渴望能成为一位顶尖的宝石设计师，而不屈服于环境，积极、认真开拓属于自己梦想，并寻找属于自己真正幸福的故事。该剧也以诙谐逗趣的手法，描写了一般老百姓为了跻身上流社会，背后所引发的虚伪与真相，也嘲讽了上流社会虚假的婚姻关系。

programme.title: 锦心似玉第44集
programme.desc: 明朝年间，庶女罗十一娘意外嫁给永平侯大将军徐令宜后，依靠努力收获徐家上下的信任，重新执掌中馈。徐令宜被十一娘吸引，继而为之动心。在丈夫的支持下，十一娘开绣坊仙绫阁，传承刺绣技艺。而永平侯徐令宜，为维护家国安宁，改善民生，力挺开放海禁。在徐家面临抄家灭族之时，夫妻齐心合力化解危局，成功护徐氏一族周全，最终促成开放海禁，至此海上贸易繁荣昌盛，沿海百姓安居乐业。

programme.desc: 《麻雀变凤凰》是讲述一位在街头贩卖饰品的摊贩郑梦希，因为渴望能成为一位顶尖的宝石设计师，而不屈服于环境，积极、认真开拓属于自己梦想，并寻找属于自己真正幸福的故事。该剧也以诙谐逗趣的手法，描写了一般老百姓为了跻身上流社会，背后所引发的虚伪与真相，也嘲讽了上流社会虚假的婚姻关系。

programme.title: 锦心似玉第45集
programme.desc: 明朝年间，庶女罗十一娘意外嫁给永平侯大将军徐令宜后，依靠努力收获徐家上下的信任，重新执掌中馈。徐令宜被十一娘吸引，继而为之动心。在丈夫的支持下，十一娘开绣坊仙绫阁，传承刺绣技艺。而永平侯徐令宜，为维护家国安宁，改善民生，力挺开放海禁。在徐家面临抄家灭族之时，夫妻齐心合力化解危局，成功护徐氏一族周全，最终促成开放海禁，至此海上贸易繁荣昌盛，沿海百姓安居乐业。

programme.title: 如懿传第64集

programme.title: 来自星星的事第47集
programme.desc: 《来自星星的事》是一部韩国浪漫奇幻剧，以异星人和地球女子之间的爱情故事为核心。剧情讲述了从400年前来自外星球的千年男子都敏俊（Do Min-joon）在地球上与现代女子千颂伊（Cheon Song-yi）相遇的故事。都敏俊拥有特殊的能力，包括超凡的力量、不老不死和超感官知觉，但他选择远离人类并过著孤独的生活。然而，当他遇到千颂伊时，他的生活开始发生改变，他们之间产生了一段跨越时空的爱情。剧中探讨了爱情、牺牲、命运和人性的主题，同时也带有一些喜剧和悬疑的元素。这部剧因其精湛的演技、浪漫的剧情和视觉效果受到观众的喜爱，成为一部受欢迎的韩剧作品。

programme.title: 闪耀的她第23集
programme.desc: 管文，身为欧洲轻奢品牌缇柏逊的业务拓展部副总监，虽是公司内年资最浅的副总监，却因做事果断狠辣被誉为「千刀斩女魔头」，是公司里传言最有希望晋升下一任总监的候选人，而这最后一步的关键即是能否拿下恒天——一家齐聚了所有顶级奢侈品牌的国内排名第一商场。但在品牌拓展团队中还有位善于投机取巧的副总监莉迪娅处处与管文针锋相对，同样觊觎品牌拓展总监之位。为了获得与恒天高层林岳的见面机会，管文便联合闺蜜陈萱萱和景知秋，上演了一出「好戏」：身著优雅贴身小礼裙的管文先是在洗手间外制造了一场与恒天招商总林岳相遇的「意外」，岂料管文的巧计被林岳的一个电话打断，她回想起总监马特的忠告和莉迪娅的挑衅，便又借景知秋装醉巧取他

programme.title: 好运家第3集
programme.desc: 私立医院优秀的内科医生郝有嘉和彭浩东来到咨询室，咨询两人婚姻问题，结果因为浩东提到郝有嘉家里都是二婚的情况而产生口角。原来郝有嘉是重组家庭长大，妈妈郝茗在她小时候就带著她改嫁给了拥有一对龙凤胎的继父罗福全…

programme.title: 牧野诡事之寻龙
programme.desc: 民国初年，传说能使死人复生的鬼仙石重现世间，更有恐怖巨龙看守，杀死一切来犯者。摸金校尉后人胡不昧、酒气冲天的逃兵老雷，与年轻貌美的木材行大小姐朱砂，三人组队共赴古墓寻宝之旅，没想到却陷入一场阴谋之中。

programme.title: 死亡漩涡-夺魂锯新游戏
programme.desc: 一系列连续杀警案，让「拼图杀人魔」重出江湖的传言再度勾起所有人心中的恐惧，但这次凶手似乎直冲著警察而来；每个命案现场留下的「死亡漩涡」，将把他们卷进难以抽身的血腥深渊之中。

programme.title: 台风
programme.desc: 一名海盗登上一艘美国货船，偷取藏于船内、以核弹操控的卫星导航系统，美国情报中心得知后，对于海盗的恣意妄为相当震怒，但碍于事件极为敏感，美国当局无法直接将海盗缉捕归案。后来，美方发现名为崔明信的海盗来自北韩，于是促请南韩代为处理。军官江世宗奉命逮捕崔明信，在办案的过程中他得知明信可怜的身世，亲人的坎坷遭遇使明信心中充满仇恨，为了向南北韩展开冷血复仇，明信决定策动一波恐怖攻击，世宗是否能及时阻止悲剧的发生？

programme.title: 正牌韦小宝之奉旨沟女
programme.desc: 鹿鼎记后若干年，康熙皇帝突生怪病，经国师卜算须寻得天命皇后方能痊愈，并卜出皇后身在未来，便下旨派遣康熙好友的韦小宝穿越时空至1993年的香港寻找，但韦小宝虽机智多变，但也风流成性，韦小宝的夫人们担心再添后宫、吴三桂心有反意亦派出手下阻止，在五光十色的香港能否顺利达成任务？

programme.desc: 喜欢魔术的高中生黑羽快斗，偶然发现自己房间中有密室。这个密室是他的父亲──世界知名的魔术师黑羽盗一，在8年前一次事故中神秘死去前所使用的。密室中放著神秘怪盗──基德的装备。黑羽快斗穿上怪盗基德的服装，并与父亲多年前的助手─寺井黄之助相遇，才知晓自己的父亲当年死于谋杀，快斗决定继承父亲怪盗基德的身份，并对父亲的死因展开调查。

programme.title: 我家的事
programme.desc: 寻找身世之谜的姊姊小春、半路认父的弟弟夏仔、试图逆转人生的老爸阿冬、挑战人工受孕的妈妈阿秋，在一个平凡的宜兰家庭，四位家人拼了命，就是为了成为彼此生命中的家人。但纷至沓来的辛酸、恐惧、落寞与勇气，却成为他们的人生难题。

programme.title: 咒术回战第41集

programme.title: 魔女二部曲-另一个她
programme.desc: 故事讲述一位年轻女孩在一个被摧毁的秘密研究所中幸存下来，对于外面的世界感到陌生。她偶然遇到了一对姊弟，他们名叫庆熙和大吉，并与他们成为了朋友。随著时间的推移，这位女孩渐渐适应了这个温暖的日常生活。然而，一些怀有不可告人秘密的势力开始追查她的行踪…

programme.title: 醉拳2
programme.desc: 故事讲述年少时的黄飞鸿（成龙）终日惹事生非，其父黄麒英为使其成才，请来好友苏乞儿（袁小田）调教他，最后飞鸿以自创的醉拳大败敌人。此片除掀起了武术喜剧的热潮外，更造就了成龙这位实力非凡的武打巨星，片中每招每式均表现出成龙的精湛武艺，袁小田曾以此片入围金马奖最佳男配角奖。

programme.title: 剑雨
programme.desc: 公元428年，天竺高人罗磨努占出家为僧，东渡中原，练成绝世武功。罗磨祖师死后，遗体下落不明。武林相传只要得到遗体，参透个中玄机，即能练成绝世神功，称霸武林，各路江湖高手于是马上蠢蠢欲动。数百年后，江湖上出现一个名为「黑石」的暗杀组织，当中以心狠手辣、从未失手的「细雨」(林熙蕾饰)最冷血无情。在一次暗杀中，她杀死一位朝廷命官，其子张人凤(郭晓冬饰)却侥幸逃过。后来，细雨在行动中遇上武艺超群的修行僧绿竹(李宗翰饰)，令她的生命泛起了涟漪。虽然绿竹苦劝细雨放下屠刀，最终却死在细雨剑下。他的死让细雨顿悟——原来杀死一个关心自己的人会有锥心之痛。最后，细雨决定告别腥风血雨的日子，重过新生。然而，落在细雨

programme.title: 拆弹专家2
programme.desc: 香港发生了一系列爆炸事件，让整个城市陷入恐慌。前拆弹专家潘乘风（由刘德华饰演）在事发现场昏迷，随即被警方视为主要嫌疑人，怀疑他与邪恶组织“复生会”有著密切的联系。苏醒后，潘乘风面对警方的强力询问和可能的入狱风险，决定逃离现场，亲自查明真相。在这条孤独无援的道路上，他找到昔日战友、拆弹专家董卓文（由刘青云饰演）请求协助，但由于他们陷入了复杂的黑白不分的境地，董卓文不得不在公与私之间做出艰难的选择。基于他们生死之交的情谊，董卓文最终决定伸出援手。同时，潘乘风的前女友庞玲（倪妮饰）现任反恐特勤队总督察，急于查明爆炸事件的背后真相，以保障市民安全。她说服潘乘风接触“复生会”，追踪这个神秘组织的下一步恐

programme.title: 月老
programme.desc: 剧情描述中，遭雷击的阿纶（柯震东 饰）来到了阴间，所有生前的记忆瞬间消失。他面临著一个抉择：是要投胎再生，还是成为神职人员？最终，阿纶选择了成为月老的新手，与性格火爆的粉红女Pinky（王净 饰）组成搭档，前往人间执行任务。当阿纶遇见狗狗阿鲁和它的主人小咪时，他的前世记忆回潮，小咪（宋芸桦 饰）正是他生前的挚爱。

programme.title: 叶问
programme.desc: 在1930年代，中国武术的发源地佛山武风鼎盛，各个武术门派为了吸纳弟子，经常举行集体比赛以展示实力。出身于当地名门的叶问（由甄子丹饰演）虽然是佛山人人皆知的高手，但他性格低调，因此没有开设武馆授徒，只是与妻儿享受家庭生活，偶尔研究武术。由金山找（樊少皇饰）领导的北方武师，为了在佛山声名显赫，便大肆挑战各派馆主。金山找为了争夺第一，决定向不问世事的叶问发起挑战，并不惜一切手段迫使叶问出手。在妻子张永成（熊黛林饰）的批准下，叶问毅然应战，凭借高超的咏春拳轻松战胜金山找。这场比赛后，叶问的名声在佛山更加响亮。然而，随著中日战争的爆发，佛山陷入敌手，叶家大宅被日军占据，叶问不得不带著妻儿搬进破旧的房屋

programme.title: 危机航线
programme.desc: 国际安保专家高皓军和失明的女儿小军搭乘有「空中巨无霸」之称的五星级超豪华客机A380的国际首航，途中遭遇暴徒劫机，无差别射杀的恐怖手段，让豪华机舱瞬间变成密闭炼狱，800多名乘客危在旦夕，高皓军挺身而出，在数千米的高空上与一众暴徒周旋，飞机能否平安降落，这场失控的危机该如何化解？

programme.title: 赌城风云
programme.desc: 闻名中外，曾担任美国赌场保安总顾问的「魔术手」石一坚（周润发饰），退休回澳门老家，徒弟们特别替他设宴贺寿。他的好友奔驰（许绍雄饰）与他儿子晒冷（谢霆锋饰）、外甥牛必胜（杜汶泽饰）也从香港前来到澳门祝贺。 翌日，中、港、澳三地警方，竟不约而同找上石一坚，希望他能够重出江湖帮忙对付D.O.A.组织集团的高先生…。

programme.title: 依法相爱吧第1集
programme.desc: 从高中交往到大学，在意想不到的情况下分手。正浩原是检察官，如今已当了三年房东，也是个游手好闲的无业游民，既狡猾又幽默，但17年来一直暗恋著琉璃。而琉璃辞掉律所工作，打算开一间咖啡厅，没想到房东竟是正浩！冤家见面分外眼红，但与正浩重逢，琉璃却对他展开直球攻势⋯
